facts.text: The Brando sits on Tetiaroa, an atoll encircled by a coral reef with 12 motus (islets).
facts.excerpt: Encircled by a coral reef, the atoll’s 12 motus hold back the vast blue beyond, cultivating a sanctuary of peace within.

facts.text: Guests reach Tetiaroa on Air Tetiaroa, a 20-minute scenic flight from Papeete, Tahiti, where international flights arrive at Faa'a International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Flights converge from across the globe at Faa’a International Airport, introducing travelers to Papeete, Tahiti, where Air Tetiaroa awaits to whisk them away on a 20-minute scenic flight to Tetiaroa.

facts.text: Guests leave from a private departure lounge and board a private plane with a handful of other guests.
facts.excerpt: After you leave our private departure lounge and board your private plane with a handful of other guests

facts.text: Marlon Brando first spied Tetiaroa on a hike in Tahiti while filming Mutiny on the Bounty in the early 1960s.
facts.excerpt: Marlon first spied Tetiaroa on a hike in Tahiti while filming Mutiny on the Bounty in the early 1960s.

facts.text: The resort opened in 2014, after the Brando Family Trust approved Pacific Beachcomber's plan in 2009.
facts.excerpt: That day came in 2009 when the Brando Family Trust granted approval to  Pacific Beachcomber, Richard Bailey’s company, to build the 35-villa resort that would be known as The Brando. The resort finally opened in 2014

facts.text: Private villas are spread across the Onetahi motu, set back just off the beach, plus one private residence.
facts.excerpt: Spread across the Onetahi motu and set back just off the beach are 35 private villas and one private residence

facts.text: Villa doors fold open to create breezeways to the outdoors.
facts.excerpt: There’s a flow to these spaces, where doors fold open to create breezeways to the outdoors

facts.text: The One Bedroom Villa has a private outdoor bathtub, an outdoor lounge deck and an infinity plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Bathroom with two sinks, shower, private outdoor bathtub

facts.text: The One Bedroom Villa features an outdoor lounge area on the deck, an outdoor covered dining area and an infinity plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor lounge area on deck, outdoor covered dining area, infinity plunge pool

facts.text: The Teremoana Residence has a fully equipped kitchen, an outdoor kitchen, a large private sandy yard with hammock and daybed at the beach, and an experience creator at guests' service.
facts.excerpt: Large private sandy yard with hammock and daybed at the beach

facts.text: The Brando was the first resort globally to receive LEED Platinum Certification.
facts.excerpt: This pioneering approach has led The Brando to become the first resort globally to receive the prestigious LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) Platinum Certification.

facts.text: Buildings are cooled with seawater and solar panels light paths at night; glass is returned to sand.
facts.excerpt: glass is returned to sand, buildings cool with seawater, and solar panels soak in the day to light paths at night

facts.text: Varua Te Ora Polynesian Spa is reached by elevated pathways that wind through tropical undergrowth to secluded treatment spaces.
facts.excerpt: The entry is a portal to elevated pathways that wind through tropical undergrowth, diverging here and there like the branches of a tree, and leading to secret abodes for relaxation, meditation, contemplation, and healing.

facts.text: Fare Manu, 'the bird house', is a treetop treatment space for two within the spa.
facts.excerpt: Fare Manu, “the bird house”, rises as a lofty sanctuary within the embrace of Varua Te Ora Spa.

facts.text: Fare Mana, just off the sand, hosts meditation, yoga and sound baths.
facts.excerpt: a sanctuary where souls are purified and the rituals of meditation, yoga, and sound baths are observed

facts.text: Tetiaroa Society naturalist guides lead excursions such as the Tetiaroa Ultimate Tour to a protected motu nicknamed 'bird island' and an old forest where coconut crabs may be seen.
facts.excerpt: The boat glides across a glistening lagoon to a protected motu, affectionately dubbed “bird island,” where seabirds swoop and dive in a playful dance.

facts.text: Reef Quest is a snorkeling trip to coral gardens at the outer barrier reef, for confident swimmers aged 12 and up.
facts.excerpt: Nearing their destination, the anchor drops, commencing a snorkeling adventure amid vibrant coral gardens.

facts.text: The Green Tour shows the seawater air conditioning system, organic gardens, solar panels and the Research Station.
facts.excerpt: The grand finale is the Research Station, a nucleus of exploration and learning

facts.text: During nesting season, guests can join Te Mana o Te Moana marine biologists on night patrols looking for nesting turtles or emerging hatchlings.
facts.excerpt: Guests can join Te Mana o Te Moana marine biologists on night patrols, moving silently in the darkness in search of females laying eggs or emerging hatchlings.

facts.text: Green sea turtles nest on Tetiaroa from September to March.
facts.excerpt: Discover Tetiaroa’s green sea turtles nesting from September to March.

facts.text: Bob's Bar is Marlon Brando's original beachside bar, serving the signature 'Bob's Last Drop' cocktail.
facts.excerpt: It is a place where patrons are encouraged to savor a signature cocktail, the ‘Bob’s Last Drop,’ and raise their glasses in a tribute to the timeless spirit of Tetiaroa.

facts.text: The resort's cooking is a fusion of Polynesian flavors and classical French techniques.
facts.excerpt: a fusion of Polynesian flavors and classical French techniques

facts.text: Les Mutinés is a dinner restaurant themed on Mutiny on the Bounty.
facts.excerpt: Les Mutinés offers an environment transformed to inspire the legendary maritime adventure, “Mutiny on the Bounty,”

facts.text: The Family One Bedroom Villa has a separate area where children sleep in twin beds.
facts.excerpt: At bedtime, the separation of bedrooms affords a quiet enclave for adults, while children nestle into their adjacent twin beds.

facts.text: The Brando was named No. 4 resort in Australasia and the South Pacific in Conde Nast Traveller's 2026 Readers' Choice Awards.
facts.excerpt: The Brando has been named the No. 4 resort in Australasia & the South Pacific in Condé Nast Traveller’s 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards, earning a score of 97.47.

facts.text: Tetiaroa was once a getaway for Tahitian royalty, and archaeological sites dot its 12 motus.
facts.excerpt: In the past, Tetiaroa was a special getaway for Tahitian royalty to retreat, entertain, and partake in beauty rituals.

facts.text: Nine species of seabirds live on Tetiaroa.
facts.excerpt: In the air, nine species of seabirds call Tetiaroa home

facts.text: The atoll is described as a beacon in sustainable luxury travel.
facts.excerpt: This atoll shines as a beacon in sustainable luxury travel, globally acclaimed for its dedication and research.
